editorial.overview: AI Fusion tours Strix agents and skills, manually demonstrates a Juice Shop login bypass and attempts agent scans that end without confirmed findings.
editorial.whyItMatters: Worth seven minutes for security-tool evaluators. Skip the opening bypass if you know the training target; the stalled local run shows what needs to be recorded.
editorial.ghostMeshTakeaway: Separate a proposal, a tool call, a completed scan and a verified finding. Evaluate only in a controlled authorized target with run records and human review.
editorial.watchGuidance: Watch 00:52–03:23 for architecture and 04:46–05:52 for the local run. Viewers familiar with Juice Shop may skip the opening manual bypass.
editorial.verdict: The presenter manually bypassed Juice Shop; the Strix attempts shown did not produce a confirmed finding. Diagnose structured tool calling before attributing the local stall to model quality alone.
editorial.thesis: A vulnerable training target, an agent architecture, and partial tool calls establish a test setup, not measured detection coverage.
